content:
Aisha Rao: Hey team — Cloudly confirmed the integration bundle and wants a coordinated push: marketplace listing + partner blog + a technical demo webinar. Do we have capacity for a 3-week sprint?
Tom B.: 3 weeks is tight but doable if we scope: marketplace + webinar + 1 co-authored blog. cut the number of assets.
Leah Kim: I can own marketplace listing copy + screenshots. Need final integration logos and a short 2-line product blurb from Cloudly.
Samantha (Cloudly): sending logos now, small legal okayed co-marketing. We want a 45min demo + 15min Q&A. Two speakers from our side.
Marcos Diaz: I'll set up the demo environment. Can we agree on a demo runbook with exact prompts and expected sample outputs? avoids surprises.
Aisha Rao: yes — Marcos please draft runbook. Leah, can you draft marketplace text and one liner for hero? Tom, you'll coordinate webinar host + registration flow?
Tom B.: Yep. Proposed webinar date: Tue May 12 @ 11am PT. Can we target that? gives us ~3 weeks.
Samantha (Cloudly): May 12 works. We'll prepare 2 engineers and a short customer success soundbite.
marketing-ops: For inbound leads: propose routing Cloudly-sourced registrants -> SFDC Campaign "CLD-Redwood-May12" and set lead owner to partner-team queue. Also add utm_source=cloudly&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=may12_demo.
Aisha Rao: Agreed. marketing-ops please add auto-tag in the registration form so we can filter. Also we need SSO invite link and re-confirm privacy copy for marketplace.
marketing-ops: Will do. Suggest using zap: event_reg -> HubSpot -> SFDC sync. I can paste the minimal mapping:
```
email -> lead.email
company -> lead.company
utm_campaign -> campaign.id
source -> lead.source = "cloudly"
```
Marcos Diaz: For the runbook, I want the exact payloads we'll send to Redwood API during demo. I'll draft sample curl commands and token-sanitized examples.
Leah Kim: Cool. Also need one short benchmark blurb comparing latency vs baseline for the integration (tiny chart). Can Research/Eng provide a 1-paragraph result?
Tom B.: I'll ping Eng-ML for a quick perf snapshot. If we can't get a full benchmark, do an honest micro-benchmark with clearly stated test harness.
Samantha (Cloudly): We can share a customer quote draft for the blog. Will add permission to use it in the co-authored post.
Aisha Rao: Action items: Marcos: runbook + sample curl (due in 48h). Leah: marketplace draft + hero blurb (48h). Tom: host + Eng-ML ping + landing page copy (48h). marketing-ops: lead routing zap + registration form fields (24h). Samantha: logos + speaker bios + customer quote (48h).
DevRel Bot: calendar created: "Cloudly x Redwood — Integration Demo" Tue May 12 11:00 AM PT. Invite sent to speakers.
Tom B.: I'll set up a short rehearsal on May 8. Marcos can you join to validate the environment?
Marcos Diaz: Yes, May 8 works. I'll also do a dry run of the curl examples in a clean environment and record any flakiness.
Leah Kim: For the marketplace screenshots, we need 1200x630 hero and a 600x400 architecture diagram. I'll mock the diagram and send to design.
Aisha Rao: Thanks. One more: let's agree on measurement — registrants, attendees, MQLs (SFDC), and partner attribution. marketing-ops, please add UTM and a campaign tag so attribution persists for 30 days.
marketing-ops: Noted — will set utm_term=integration and cookie window 30d.
Samantha (Cloudly): Anything we should track on our side? we'll include a CTA in our marketplace listing that points to the joint landing page.
Aisha Rao: Perfect. Final note: keep messaging honest about supported features and any limitations (quantization/latency tradeoffs). We don't want surprise support tickets.
Tom B.: Agreed. I'll add an FAQ section to the registration page with known limitations.
Aisha Rao: Great sync. I'll compile the action list and post a follow-up doc in the #marketing channel after lunch. Thanks everyone :rocket:
